result.summary: This PR adds three new test cases to test/functional/mempool_accept.py that each isolate one of the three Taproot witness standardness rules in IsWitnessStandard: nonstandard annexes, oversized tapscript stack items, and empty control blocks. The author verified each case actually exercises its intended rule by disabling the corresponding branch in policy.cpp and confirming the test then fails. It is a small, single-file, single-commit diff with no behavior change outside tests.
result.problem: Currently no test asserts that the bad-witness-nonstandard reject reason is triggered by any of the three Taproot-specific standardness rules; existing tests either cover other output types or use a generic RPC error check that doesn't pin down which rule fired. This leaves those three policy branches without regression protection, which developers modifying Taproot standardness policy would feel if a change silently broke one of them.
